steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How is Mr. Lin doing?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The doctor says he'll be fine.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's just that his old injuries and overuse of Arts have taken a toll on him.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad is getting old, after all.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sometimes I forget how long Mr. Lin has served Lungmen.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad is not like Chief Wei. As the symbol of Lungmen, Chief Wei always stays in the public eye.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: But Lungmen doesn't exactly want everyone remembering that there is a Rat King of Downtown.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I heard Wei Yenwu dragged you into this.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It became my business when I chose to accept it, of my own accord.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: And it all turned out fine, thanks to a certain someone.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tsk.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: This incident also helped me answer a couple of questions.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you going to Victoria? We could travel together.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: No, my plans have changed.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm going back to Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What do you mean by 'going back to Lungmen?'

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm staying.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Throwing off your burdens sounds nice, but whatever you throw off, somebody else has to pick up.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Whether one leaves or stays is up to oneself, but someone has to take care of Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I said that for me, but feel free to take it as a criticism, if you want.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Glad to see you still have the strength to joke.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The daughter of the Rat King doesn't have to be the Rat King, but it doesn't mean she can't be.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: She could be a different sort of Rat King.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: This time, I made my own choice.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: There are slums in Lungmen, but there shouldn't be. It's a job that someone has to do, no matter how many years go by.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The times are changing, but no one should be left behind.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I believe that, when it's you saying it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: By the way...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What is it? Your turn to hem and haw?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Have you seen Wei Yenwu these past few days?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Are you leaving, Grandmaster?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Once I've handed over my duties.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Speaking of which, I must thank you.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: For what?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You chose to trust Yumen.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: And you chose to trust my friends.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It's all water under the bridge.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We suffered some losses, but we should count ourselves fortunate that the situation remained under control.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: More importantly, I saw how the people here remain united, even after so many years.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Yumen hasn't changed. Man will triumph over Heaven.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Now I can be at ease about leaving.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There's no telling when we'll meet again.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Take care, Grandmaster.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You too. Beware the intrigue of the court.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: By the way, you said something about Ch'en's swordsmanship yesterday.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: 'Skillful, but not yet the peak of perfection.'

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Yes, I remember.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Ch'en has talent, but she only just started learning the Chi Xiao style recently.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: She has not mastered its true essence.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Ah, you wanted to show off your skills.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I said before that Cloud-splitting sword is not actually Chi Xiao's ultimate move.
His fingers are his sword.
A light breeze begins blowing out of nowhere, creating tiny ripples in the teacup.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The ultimate move of Chi Xiao, Heaven's Eye.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The form?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The eye of Heaven sees all and nothing.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The concept?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Only when the clouds are parted is Heaven's wrathful eye revealed.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: One must free one's mind to learn the form.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The obstacle?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Let your heart guide the sword, never looking back.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Turn around, and the sword loses its sharpness, harming the user.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Farewell.
The breeze continues to blow, long after the chair is empty.
The man gazes into the ripples in the teacup, until a smile appears on his face.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I have never seen the likes of it.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Grand Tutor.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You understand that entering Yumen without permission is enough to carry the suspicion of treason on its own?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Lord Wei was attacked, and trapped in Yumen, while Yumen travels towards the capital...

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: We were concerned for Lord Wei's safety. The urgency of the situation did not allow for deliberation.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: We have nothing but our lives to repay Lord Wei's kindness.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Did Wei Yenwu tell you to look for him in Yumen if he did not return in three days?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: That is so.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I can tell you now that both the assassination attempt on Wei Yenwu and the crisis at Yumen were accidents. There is no need to worry.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Where were you when the Catastrophe happened?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: We operated in secret, eliminating insurgents stealthily.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: At least you did one thing you were supposed to.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You may go.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: We are not subject to the Grand Tutor's punishment?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: As far as the Imperial Guard is concerned, all of you are already dead.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I never saw you today.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Yes, Grand Tutor.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You knew.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: From the beginning.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: And you never had any intention of hiding it from me.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Do you not reproach me for overstepping my boundaries?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The situation remained under control thanks to the young envoy that you brought from Lungmen.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The Grand Commandant will soon learn of this incident.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: 'Soon' is not the word I would use.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: This is why I came to Yumen.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There is no consensus on how we should deal with the bestial Sui, whether we should prepare for war, or reconciliation. It is hard to see the forest when one is amongst the trees.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The minds of some of the parties concerned may no longer be on finding the right answer.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You wanted to help the Lord Exorcist eliminate the insurgents out of a sense of duty to Yan.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: As long as you don't lose sight of it, you won't need me to tell you what to do.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I will remember your teachings.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You have always been a good student.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I remember when I taught you and your brother. You were always the quicker learner.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Are you injured?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Just a scratch.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The Tumu Tianshi say it was you who protected the sand sluices.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I let them get away, though.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: By the way, I came to say goodbye.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I will find a place where this sword will realize its potential, even if you're not with me anymore.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I have no doubt you will succeed.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: There is no more hatred between us, but I haven't given up on surpassing you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I'll come and find you, when I feel ready.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Like I said, anytime you feel ready.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: See you again.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: No regrets?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: What regrets?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Who will she seek if one day It wakes from Its dream, and you and I return to the void?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: She managed to let go of her obsession with vengeance at her age. She will let another one go when I'm gone, and forgotten from her mind.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Then the sky is the limit for her on the path of kung fu.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Well, you are the Grandmaster. You're the authority on kung fu.

spans.text: the Grandmaster. You're the authority on kung fu.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Speaking of which, I think you just gave birth to a new legend when you single-handedly turned away the Catastrophe on the walls.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I was drunk. I have no memory of those events.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: When you sober up, raise another flask. Where will you be going?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Where Nian and Dusk went.

steps.name: Observer
steps.text: The man has been playing against himself the whole afternoon, not speaking or inviting anyone to play against him.

steps.name: Observer
steps.text: His moves are brilliant, but eccentric. There were a few that confused me.

steps.name: Observer
steps.text: Some Go grandmaster I've never heard of? But why would he come to a place like Yumen?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Oh?
A man faces a Go board outside a parlor. He is not playing against a manual; he thinks for a long time before each move, as though locked in a struggle against himself.
Black and white pieces intertwine on the rough wooden board, setting into motion a dazzling battle.

steps.name: Go Player
steps.text: Do you know Go?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: A little.

steps.name: Go Player
steps.text: What do you think about the board?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The battle has been decided in three places. The balance of power is roughly even.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: But white pieces occupy a large area in the center, with no isolated pieces. It seems inevitable that black will lose by half a point...

steps.name: Go Player?
steps.text: Look again.

steps.name: Go Player?
steps.text: I've taught you.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: There is one ko left in the corner.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Keep the ploy and take the last area.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: White is spread out, with more to protect... therefore, more ammunition for my ko.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: The match is not over.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You won't give up. You'll go on until a winner has been determined.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: The Go game doesn't matter. I'm playing against me, in order to determine a winner.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: Your sword taught me a few things. This game state is my gift to you.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I knew you had pieces around me.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I just didn't know you had already lost faith in humanity then.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: Man and beast are different.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: You sealed yourself in the sword in exchange for a human body. You treated yourself as one of them. What became of you in the end?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: All your friends are gone. You wander afar, alone. No one trusts you, no one knows.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: It's not that you don't know the hearts of man. No, you know it all too well. For centuries, you have always been the one most connected to them. How would you not know?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: You could not blend in because you know that the hearts of man are unpredictable. You will always be an outsider.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: All the things you've done since Jie disappeared, you did to find someone to talk to.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: We've been lonely for far too long. We want to find someone to talk to.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: We've fought for so many years. How ironic that we would end up knowing each other best.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: You were never my enemy.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: Never once did I consider you my enemy... even if it was you who stopped me then.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I'll stop you again, if you drag people into your Go game.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: Of course you will. Assuming, of course, that you can see the board.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: We'll meet again.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Voice
steps.text: Farewell, brother.
Chongyue picks up a white piece and puts it down in a corner.
Slap.
An orthodox, classic move.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: General.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: The Grandmaster planned to write the Book of Kung Fu twenty years ago, but the responsibilities of Yumen kept him busy.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: Work finally began on it five years ago, with the Grandmaster dictating it to me. I finally finished editing it yesterday.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: It is a record of the Grandmaster's observations and interpretations of all kung fu under Heaven, every school and branch known to man.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: Grandmaster wants you to have it.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: Grandmaster says that there is much in common between kung fu and medicine. He has included some instructions in the appendix, which he hopes will improve your health.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Where is the Grandmaster?

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: He left Yumen an hour ago.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: He says he has already sent away the 'guest', and you will be able to focus on dealing with things after the disaster.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: He regrets not saying goodbye in person.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Why didn't you go with him?

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: I've been with the Grandmaster since he saved my life ten years ago. I began helping him record the martial arts of the world when I grew up, meeting many great heroes along the way.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: The Grandmaster says that all I need to do is to study all that I've seen and heard during these years, if I wish to pursue the martial arts.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: And if I do not wish to do so, I should go and find something I want to do, now that the Book of Kung Fu is complete.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: 'Life is a long journey.'

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: He has always been like this.
The more whimsical encounters there are, the more ties one needs to let go of.
Man values formality, beasts value empathy.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Rescue and relief efforts have begun, sir.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: ...The sun is setting.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Oh, the Wangfeng Festival...

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Yesterday was the last day, but the beacon-lighting ceremony was suspended because of the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Would you like to resume it?

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Of course.
The wizened general gazes beyond the city and sees nothing but sand.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: I will beat the drum myself.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Sir, you've been in the tower all day. You should rest. We'll take care of it.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: The journey is long. Someone should see him off.
All your companions have returned. Where do you fly off to, alone?
The drumbeats begin.
They are heavy, ringing clear and far.
Seventeen beats of the drum, representing the trials and tribulations that befell Yumen the past year, both big and small.
The Catastrophe has passed. The storm has swept away the many colors in the sky.
The clouds burn bright red, scorched by the setting sun.
He walks forward, the wind and sand slowly wiping away his footprints. The great city of Yumen grows smaller in the distance.
Thump—
Eighteen.
He stops briefly, but does not turn.
The eighteenth beat of the drum, symbolizing yet another Catastrophe survived by Yumen.
And...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I'll be going.

a.text: Break clouds by rays on all that be,
Are scooped the stars 'til star's bed fades, and like another, we are lone.

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: We made it out.

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Thank you for digging up the Patrol Battalion's activities, or we would have been goners inside.

steps.name: Calm Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: We got a message by Di beast. Boss and the others have set out for the next location. We should hurry and meet up with them.

steps.name: Calm Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: (Grinds teeth)

steps.name: Calm Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Yumen... next time...

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Hey, isn't that the one who...?

steps.name: Calm Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: You followed us?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Followed? I just stopped to take a break on my way out of Yumen.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: But I guess fate meant for us to meet again.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Perfect. I'll send you on your way.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: And then I'll be on mine.
